column1: # Table S3: exact GWAS Catalog reported trait names used to identify trait-matched associations for each phenotype.
# One row per phenotype x name. Phenotype names as in config/pipeline.yaml without the _rint suffix.
# Names are matched to the Catalog 'trait' column exactly (case-insensitive, surrounding spaces ignored).
# sitting_height_mm and bmi_at_25 have no Catalog trait of their own: height and BMI are used as the closest traits.
